big: A share has bounced three times near ₹480 and failed to cross ₹620 several times. Traders watch such levels because many decisions were made there before. Levels are guides, not guarantees. Education, not a call to trade.

lines: Support is a level where buying has tended to stop a fall. Resistance is a level where selling has tended to stop a rise. A breakout is a move through one of them, ideally on strong volume. Head and shoulders is a pattern often seen as a reversal sign.

rows: a close above ₹620 on heavy volume

note: Levels can fail. Confirm with other signals.

pts: Support: buying has stopped falls. Resistance: selling has stopped rises.
Breakout: a move through a level, ideally on strong volume.
